title: MiCA CASP Authorisation & Capital Readiness Checker
description: Assesses whether a Crypto-Asset Service Provider meets MiCA Title V authorisation requirements. Covers capital floors (€50k/€125k/€150k), asset segregation, AML/Travel Rule, whitepaper obligations, and EBA Feb 2026 PSD2 dual-authorisation opinion for EMT handlers.
